facts.fact: Reuben 对表亲说掺毒的药又回流街头，半年毫无进展——同样的毒杀死了他的妻子和他的父亲。
facts.anchor: The same laced drugs are back on the streets again. Six months and we aren’t any closer to stopping them. The same drugs that killed my wife. That killed your father.

facts.fact: Reuben 与亡妻是家族联姻，只做了十四天夫妻，愧疚却要背负一生。
facts.anchor: While she and I only had fourteen days together, the guilt would last me a lifetime.

facts.fact: Roux 家传说厄运会在遇到命定之人后消散，Reuben 认为是自己的厄运杀死了妻子。
facts.anchor: “They say our bad luck goes away when we meet the person we’re supposed to bring into the family.

facts.fact: Reuben 提到 The Marbled Bison 餐厅又失火——刀掉进烤面包机引发电火，副主厨被开除，他的预订也被取消。
facts.anchor: did you hear The Marbled Bison caught fire again? This time, a knife landed in a toaster

facts.fact: 表亲从裤袋里掏出一张六人名单摔在桌上。
表亲用亡父的人脉一路追查，指认同样的毒既杀了 Reuben 的妻子也杀了他父亲。
facts.anchor: I used my father’s contacts. Followed the trail. The same drugs that took my father out, killed your wife.

facts.fact: Reuben 叫住表亲 Orzo，问他那晚在场的另一个女人查到什么没有。
facts.anchor: “Orzo, the night your father died, there was another woman. Did you find anything on her?”

facts.fact: Orzo 说女人有个女儿，女孩在寄养系统里失联，母女都查不到下落，但没有死亡的迹象。
facts.anchor: But the girl got lost in foster care. I couldn’t uncover anything else on either of them. But there are no signs she has died.
